facts.text: The supported hardware table lists the EDUX1052G and DSOX1102G as verified and other InfiniiVision models as likely compatible
The constructor creates pyvisa's pure-Python ResourceManager '@py'
connect() opens the VISA resource, sets the timeout and uses newline read and write terminators
The connection sets :WAVeform:UNSigned OFF and :WAVeform:BYTeorder LSBFirst for waveform transfers
idn() queries *IDN?
reset() writes *RST
opc() queries *OPC? and returns True only when the reply is '1'
run(), stop() and single() write :RUN, :STOP and :SINGle
autoscale() writes :AUToscale
get_error() reads one entry of the error FIFO with :SYSTem:ERRor? and returns a code and message
The upstream close() attempts :RUN before closing the VISA session and suppresses both errors
measure() selects :MEASure:SOURce CHANnel<n> and then queries :MEASure:<item>? CHANnel<n>, returning a float
The DSL lists the measurement names vpp, vmax, vmin, vamp, vtop, vbase, vavg, vrms, freq, per, rise, fall, pwid, nwid, duty, over and preshoot
The DSL accepts only channel 1 or 2 for channel configuration
The DSL calls parse_voltage for channel scale and offset
The DSL calls parse_time for timebase scale and position
The DSL calls parse_voltage for the trigger level
parse_voltage converts voltage strings to volts
parse_time converts time strings to seconds
The DSL acquisition modes are NORMal, AVERage, HRESolution and PEAK
query_binary reads an IEEE 488.2 #n<length><data> binary block
get_waveform sets :WAVeform:SOURce, :WAVeform:FORMat, :WAVeform:POINts and reads :WAVeform:PREamble? before :WAVeform:DATA?

measures.description: Number of averages for AVERage acquisition
measures.name: acquire_count

operator_required.name: channel1_scale_v_per_div
operator_required.reason: the clone states no vertical scale range; it depends on the model, the probe ratio and the vertical window (keyscope_mcp/scope.py:274-283 only selects the waveform source)

operator_required.name: channel1_offset_v
operator_required.reason: the clone states no offset range; it depends on the vertical scale and the probe ratio (keyscope_mcp/dsl.py:243-244 only parses a voltage)

operator_required.name: timebase_scale_s_per_div
operator_required.reason: the clone states no timebase scale range; it depends on the model and the timebase mode (keyscope_mcp/dsl.py:283-284 only parses a time)

operator_required.name: timebase_position_s
operator_required.reason: the clone states no timebase position range; it depends on the timebase scale (keyscope_mcp/dsl.py:291-292 only parses a time)

operator_required.name: trigger_level_v
operator_required.reason: the clone states no trigger level range; it depends on the trigger source and the vertical scale (keyscope_mcp/dsl.py:339-341 only parses a voltage)

safe_state.description: acquisition stop (:STOP) acknowledged by *OPC? = 1 and a zero error-FIFO code; this is command completion, not a sensed acquisition-state read; session close sends no :RUN
